title: Corvid Origin
description: An Origins datapack heavily based off the Crow Datapack by abyss_hermit
body:
A crow origin I made* with help from https://www.mathgeniuszach.com/apps/origin-creator/

*Bones of the datapack are from https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/crow-origin/ and were modified, heavily.



Required mods: Origins, of course, and APugLi for seed eating, as well as all the mods those two require.

Added bread, chocolate, and seed tags for Farmer's Delight Refabricated, Expanded Delight, End's Delight, and Fright's Delight, as well as infection immunity for Fright's Delight.



## **Description**

Corvids are a race of small beings who are more bird than humanoid.

## **Powers**

- **Winged:** You have natural wings, allowing you to glide without equipping elytra. Pressing [Primary Ability] will allow you to leap up in to the air, though you can only fly for so long before you have to rest on the ground.
- **Hollow Bones:** You're light and take less damage from falling or hitting the wall, but your bones can't take a hit so you have half health.
- **Talons:** Manipulating things is difficult with just talons and a beak. You cannot use a shield.
- **Scavenger Digestion:** You can eat nearly anything, though some things aren't good for you. While you can eat rotten flesh with no problems and can eat seeds, bread isn't filling and slows you down, while chocolate is downright poisonous!
- **Small Stature:** You are one block tall, and have difficulty jumping up a full block or reaching very far, though your wings can help make up for that.

This is my first time doing anything like this, and it may be a bit jank or overpowered. Please leave (kind) suggestions if you have anything to say!
